coverage.row: Acceptance 1: standard tar and raw gzip preserve nested/binary/long UTF-8 dependency files, empty directories and disjoint payload/control paths.
Acceptance 2: deterministic standard extractable file entries with fixed metadata/timestamps and byte-stable ordering.
Acceptance 2: raw gzip and HTTP-decoded tar share uncompressed-content SHA-256 identity.
Acceptance 3: legacy v3 JSON/gzip and replay-cache integrity remain valid.
Fault matrix: bad checksum/truncation, unsafe/duplicate/ancestor paths, unsupported types and control entries reject before destination effects.
Fault matrix: mismatched snapshot identity never admits bytes; absent/altered replay closure fails before mutation.
Fault matrix: existing compressed/decoded 128 MiB caps and typed fetch/decompress failures remain through the bounded stream owner.
